Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Exit Fix: Exit Game (title menu) Closes Cleanly v2026.10.20
Metadata.Note:
For use with Bloodborne_exit_game.xml (Exit Game (title menu)), applied after it. 
That patch ends the game with the game's own exit(0), which runs the game's destructors while its threads still run: 
18 [Dantelion2 Panic] lines (invalid mutex) at every exit. 
This sends the port's quit request (bb:q through sceSystemServiceLaunchWebBrowser) instead, the same way the port's own Quit to Desktop closes the game.
Metadata.Author: Jin-Gu

Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: Compatibility Fix: SSR with the Performance Patch v2026.10.24
Metadata.Note:
For 'Enable Screen Space Reflections (READ NOTE)' (on in the launcher) together with the external Bloodborne.xml performance patch (성능향상패치). 
SSR turns mov byte [r13+0x2977],1 at 0x26C4FD0 into mov byte [r13+0x2974],1, its switch. 
The port applies the performance patch after it, and that patch writes 00 at 0x026C4FD7, the switch value: SSR stays off. 
This writes SSR's 01 back after both. With SSR off in the launcher the byte is the game's original value; turn this off too then.
Metadata.Author: Jin-Gu
